div.head: I As 2
div.ab: Uton geþencan, hu Iacob cwæð se heahfæder: 'Decimas et hostias pacificas offeram tibi'; and hu Moyses cwæð on Godes lage: 'Decimas et primitias non tardabis offerre Domino.'
Utan geþencan, hu Iacob cwæð se heahfæder: ‘Decimas et hostias pacificas offeram tibi’; ⁊ hu Moyses cwæð on Godes lage: ‘Decimas et primitias non tardabis offerre Domino’.

Utan geþencan we, hwæt Iacob se hiehfæder to ðam Drihten cwæþ: ‘Ic ðe wille gesyllan mine teoþan ⁊ mine siblac’. And Drihten seolfe on ðam godspel cwæþ: ‘Eallum ðæm hæbbendum mon sceal agyfan, ⁊ hi genyhtsumiaþ’.
Cogitemus, quid Iacob pater excelsus dixerit Deo: ‘Decimas et hostias pacificas offeram tibi’. Et Dominus ipse dixit in ewangelio suo: ‘Omni habenti dabitur et habundabit’.
Utan geþencan, hu Iacob cwæð se heahfæder: "Decimas et hostias pacificas offeram tibi"; ⁊ hu Moyses cwæð on Godes lage: "Decimas et primitias non tardabis offere Domino."
Utan geþencan, hu Iacob cwæð se heahfæder: decimas et hostias pacificas offeram tibi; and hu Moyses cwæð on Godes lage: decimas et primitias non tardabis offerre Domino.
Let us remember how Jacob the Patriarch declared: "Decimus et hostias pacificas offeram tibi"; and how Moses declared in God's law: "Decimus et primitias non tardibus offere Domino."
Let us recall how the patriarch Jacob said, tithes and sacrifices I offer to you; and how Moses proclaimed in God’s law, do not hesitate to offer tithes and first fruits unto the Lord.

Lasst uns eingedenk sein, wie (was lq) Jacob der Patriarch (zum Herrn lq) sprach: ‘Ich will Dir geben (meine Ld) Zehnten und (meine Ld) Friedensopfer’; und wie Moses sprach in Gottes Gesetz: ‘Decimas et primitias non tardabis offerre Domino’. (Und der Herr selbst sprach im Evangelium: ‘Allen, den Habenden wird gegeben werden, und sie werden Überfluss haben’. lq).

Let us bear in mind how (what, lq) Jacob the patriarch said (to the Lord, lq): ‘I will give you (my, Ld) tithes and (my, Ld) peace-offerings’; and how Moses said in God's law: ‘You shall not delay to offer tithes and first-fruits to the Lord’. (And the Lord himself said in the gospel: ‘To all who have it shall be given, and they shall have abundance’. lq).
div.note: tithes and sacrifices I offer to you: A reworking of Genesis 28:22. do not hesitate to offer tithes and first fruits unto the Lord: A reworking of Exodus 22:29 and Leviticus 27:30. The Latin version of the text quotes Matthew 25:29. The fact that this particular rephrasing of Exodus occurs several times in the collection of canon law excerpts compiled by Wulfstan, as well as the archbishop’s tendency to cite Exodus’s prescriptions on tithes, makes it likely that he was responsible for the substitution.
